node.statement: Writing the amplification entrywise, the (i,j) block of (Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)^dagger equals the (i,j) block of (Ha^Q_{R,P})_n(Z^dagger); hence the two amplified operators are equal. Since the instance fixed in node 1.1 was arbitrary, this proves node 1 with e_adj as chosen there.
